cases.result_scope: time to event by day 90 in all randomized participants
facts: Some participants discontinued assigned treatment before day 90.
Survival status was obtained at day 90 for every randomized participant.
Administrative censoring occurred after day 90 at a shared data cutoff.
The report provides the randomized denominator and observed outcome count separately from the event count.

cases.result_scope: treatment-emergent adverse events through week 12 in the randomized population
facts: The randomized denominator is 100 per arm and 96 outcomes were observed per arm.
Eight participants had at least one event; event count is a numerator, not an outcome-observed count.
Four participants were excluded from the reported analysis after randomization and no outcomes were imputed.
An as-treated comparison changes group attribution but does not vary unobserved adverse-event values.

cases.result_scope: time to clinical event by month 6 in all randomized participants
facts: Clinical-event status was unavailable for 18 of 100 randomized participants.
The unavailable participants stopped follow-up after worsening symptoms.
The sensitivity analysis only reclassified treatment groups and did not vary unobserved event values.
The source does not establish that administrative censoring caused the missingness.
Death was ascertained from the same registry at the same time point in each randomized group.
The registry definition is valid for death and has no elicitation, attribution, or grading judgment.
The assessor identity was documented and blinded to assigned intervention.
No intervention-related difference in detection opportunity was reported.
The same standardized questionnaire and threshold were used in each randomized group.
Participants completed the questionnaire, but the source does not establish whether they knew assignment.
Symptom elicitation and attribution require participant judgment even though the instrument is standardized.
No source evidence shows that awareness actually changed the score.
The composite includes an objective laboratory threshold and a symptom component graded by an unblinded clinician.
The same schedule was offered, but the intervention group received extra visits that created more opportunities to detect symptoms.
The clinician expected benefit and recorded intervention-attributed symptom improvement before the endpoint.
The objective component does not erase uncertainty about the subjective component or the detection pathway.

cases.result_scope: change from baseline at week 12 in the approved randomized comparison using an adjusted mean difference
facts: The embedded SAP identifies the approved comparison, cohort, endpoint, time window, population, analysis, and effect measure.
The SAP version is signed before investigators could access unblinded outcome data.
The reported Result matches each planned field and no eligible alternative analysis is omitted without explanation.

cases.result_scope: event-free survival at month 12 in all randomized participants
facts: The report says an analysis plan existed but no protocol, SAP, or registry plan was captured.
The report contains no source-located detail about the intended population, analysis, or effect measure.
The missing plan does not prove selective reporting.

cases.result_scope: risk difference at week 24 in the approved population
facts: The original plan and a later amended plan are both captured with source-located content.
The amendment date is known, but the source does not establish when unblinded outcome data became available.
The registry posting and retrieval dates are known but do not establish historical investigator intent.
The data cutoff is reported but is not treated as investigator unblinding.

cases.result_scope: the approved intervention comparison in one platform cohort
facts: A platform master protocol and a cohort-specific SAP are both available.
The master protocol applies to several intervention comparisons, while the reported Result comes from one cohort.
The captured master protocol does not establish applicability to the approved comparison, cohort, or effect measure.
The cohort-specific analysis is not available.

cases.result_scope: the approved endpoint and time window in all randomized participants
facts: The source reports adjusted, unadjusted, complete-case, and imputed analyses.
The plan does not identify which analyses were eligible or which one was intended for the approved Result.
The report does not link the selected analysis to outcome results or justify the subset reported.
Multiplicity alone does not establish results-driven selection.
